outgoingFlows.description: New HIV infection through sexual contact with infected individuals; transmission probability varies by phase (acute, chronic, final)
Birth/recruitment into susceptible population at birth rate
Testing and initiation of antiretroviral therapy after screening
Death from HIV disease progression (Weibull survival) and background mortality
Drop-out from ART or treatment failure
Death from disease progression on treatment and background mortality

parameters.name: β
parameters.description: Initial transmission parameter

parameters.name: λ (location)
parameters.description: Transmission parameter location (shape of transmission curve)

parameters.name: n (shape)
parameters.description: Transmission parameter shape

parameters.name: ε (relative transmission on ART)
parameters.description: Relative transmissibility of individuals on ART compared to untreated

parameters.name: Birth rate μ
parameters.description: Birth/recruitment rate into the population

parameters.name: Background mortality rate δ
parameters.description: Background (non-HIV) mortality rate

parameters.name: Progression rate untreated φ
parameters.description: Disease progression rate for untreated individuals

parameters.name: Progression rate treated γ
parameters.description: Disease progression rate for individuals on ART

parameters.name: Intervention timing t
parameters.description: Year when intervention (universal testing and ART) begins

parameters.name: Intervention rate r
parameters.description: Rate of roll-out of the intervention

parameters.name: Intervention maximum m
parameters.description: Maximum coverage of the intervention

parameters.name: Testing rate σ
parameters.description: Rate of HIV testing

parameters.name: Testing refusal θ
parameters.description: Proportion refusing HIV testing

parameters.name: Drop-out rate ω
parameters.description: Rate of dropping out of ART

parameters.name: Treatment failure rate κ
parameters.description: Rate of virological treatment failure on ART

parameters.name: Other interventions reduction ψ
parameters.description: Reduction in transmission from other interventions (e.g. condoms, circumcision)

parameters.name: Survival median
parameters.description: Median survival time without treatment (Weibull distribution)

parameters.name: Survival shape
parameters.description: Shape parameter of Weibull survival distribution

parameters.name: Acute phase duration
parameters.description: Duration of the acute phase of HIV infection

parameters.name: Acute phase infectivity
parameters.description: Infectivity during the acute phase

parameters.name: Chronic phase infectivity
parameters.description: Infectivity during the chronic phase

parameters.name: Final phase infectivity
parameters.description: Infectivity during the final phase

parameters.name: Final phase duration
parameters.description: Duration of the final phase as a proportion of expected survival

parameters.name: Concurrency number
parameters.description: Number of concurrent sexual partners

parameters.name: Partnership duration
parameters.description: Mean duration of a sexual partnership

parameters.name: Initial CD4 mu
parameters.description: Location parameter for initial CD4 count distribution

parameters.name: Initial CD4 sigma
parameters.description: Shape parameter for initial CD4 count distribution
